cells.notes: This is the brief's WORST MTNL cell (-64.4% vs an independent source). MECHANISM: Screener.in's own quoted 'Sales' for this exact quarter is 145.0. That is NOT the originally-filed 51.66 -- it is the RESTATED figure MTNL's own NEXT filing (30/09/2025, see that cell below) shows for this SAME quarter's comparative column: 145.12. MTNL has been reclassifying large amounts between 'Revenue from operations' and 'Other Income' from filing to filing WITHOUT changing PAT (PAT stays 941.03 in both the original and the restated presentation). Our stored value is the quarter's OWN ORIGINALLY-FILED figure, the correct convention; the independent source appears to be tracking whichever filing most recently restated that quarter, not what was filed for it at the time. This is a 'restated vs as-reported' timing mismatch (the project's own precedent class, memory: 'CON slot holding a COPY of std' RE-ADJUDICATED note on restated-vs-as-reported), not a wrong-row read.
